paragraphs: Yeiva, the father-in-law of Ashyan bar Nadbakh.
Mentioned in [Bava Batra 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.22b.7): he spoke in the name of Rav.[^1]

notes.text: The linked passage calls Yeiva the father-in-law of Ashyan bar Nadbakh and has him transmit a ruling about the width of a window in Rav’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1614&lang=en) records the same kinship and chain.
